system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a Kubernetes CronJob manifest that runs a nightly database backup script (image: myorg/db-backup:2.1) at 02:00 UTC every day.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Create a Kubernetes CronJob manifest that runs a nightly database backup script (image: myorg/db-backup:2.1) at 02:00 UTC every day.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: db-backup-nightly
  labels:
    app: db-backup
    schedule: nightly
spec:
  schedule: "0 2 * * *"
  timeZone: "Etc/UTC"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  suspend: false
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 3600
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 2
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 3
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app: db-backup
            job: db-backup-nightly
        spec:
          automountServiceAccountToken: false
          restartPolicy: Never
          terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            runAsGroup: 1000
            fsGroup: 1000
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
          containers:
            - name: db-backup
              image: myorg/db-backup:2.1
              imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
              securityContext:
                allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
                privileged: false
                capabilities:
                  drop:
                    - ALL
              resources:
                requests:
                  cpu: "200m"
                  memory: "256Mi"
                limits:
                  cpu: "1"
                  memory: "1Gi"
              env:
                - name: TZ
                  value: "UTC"
              volumeMounts:
                - name: tmp
                  mountPath: /tmp
          volumes:
            - name: tmp
              emptyDir: {}
